newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes lower on rain in the Plains.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes lower on rain in the Plains.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower on weekend rainfall in portions of dry wheat areas of western Kansas, traders said.

Grain dealers said rain was noted in central and eastern Kansas and Oklahoma and there were light showers in western Kansas. But northwest Kansas remained dry with 90-degree temperatures over the weekend.
Traders said more rain was needed to help Kansas yields.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed 1/2 to 4-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with July down 4-1/2 at $4.19-1/2.
KCBT wheat futures volume was estimated at 33.275 million bushels, below the 35.125 million traded Friday.
